index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..22a6baeab23259b7eb95d7d523011a07e4cc06ad
--- /dev/null
+++ b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-07-30T203242Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/web/src/main.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,149 @@
+import React, { FormEvent, useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import ReactDOM from "react-dom/client";
+import {
+  createPublicClient, createWalletClient, custom, formatUnits, http, parseUnits,
+  type Address,
+} from "viem";
+import { toolshedAbi, usdcAbi } from "./abi";
+import "./styles.css";
+
+declare global {
+  interface Window { ethereum?: Parameters<typeof custom>[0] }
+}
+
+const contract = import.meta.env.VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS as Address;
+const usdc = import.meta.env.VITE_USDC_ADDRESS as Address;
+const chainId = Number(import.meta.env.VITE_CHAIN_ID ?? 31337);
+const publicClient = createPublicClient({ transport: http(import.meta.env.VITE_RPC_URL) });
+
+type Tool = {
+  id: bigint;
+  owner: Address;
+  name: string;
+  photoURI: string;
+  condition: string;
+  deposit: bigint;
+  dailyLateFee: bigint;
+  status: number;
+  active: boolean;
+  completedLoans: bigint;
+  lateReturns: bigint;
+};
+
+function App() {
+  const [account, setAccount] = useState<Address>();
+  const [tools, setTools] = useState<Tool[]>([]);
+  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
+
+  async function refresh() {
+    const count = await publicClient.readContract({ address: contract, abi: toolshedAbi, functionName: "toolCount" });
+    const rows = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Number(count) }, async (_, index) => {
+      const id = BigInt(index + 1);
+      const [tool, rep] = await Promise.all([
+        publicClient.readContract({ address: contract, abi: toolshedAbi, functionName: "tools", args: [id] }),
+        publicClient.readContract({
+          address: contract, abi: toolshedAbi, functionName: "tools", args: [id],
+        }).then(result => publicClient.readContract({
+          address: contract, abi: toolshedAbi, functionName: "reputation", args: [result[0]],
+        })),
+      ]);
+      return {
+        id, owner: tool[0], name: tool[1], photoURI: tool[2], condition: tool[3],
+        deposit: tool[4], dailyLateFee: tool[5], status: tool[6], active: tool[7],
+        completedLoans: rep[0], lateReturns: rep[1],
+      };
+    }));
+    rows.sort((a, b) => {
+      const aGood = a.completedLoans - a.lateReturns;
+      const bGood = b.completedLoans - b.lateReturns;
+      return Number(bGood * (a.completedLoans || 1n) - aGood * (b.completedLoans || 1n));
+    });
+    setTools(rows.filter(tool => tool.active));
+  }
+
+  useEffect(() => { refresh().catch(error => setMessage(error.shortMessage ?? error.message)); }, []);
+
+  async function connect() {
+    if (!window.ethereum) return setMessage("Install an EIP-1193 wallet first.");
+    const [selected] = await createWalletClient({ transport: custom(window.ethereum) }).requestAddresses();
+    setAccount(selected);
+  }
+
+  async function write(functionName: "listTool" | "requestLoan", args: readonly unknown[]) {
+    if (!window.ethereum || !account) return setMessage("Connect your wallet first.");
+    const wallet = createWalletClient({ transport: custom(window.ethereum) });
+    const hash = await wallet.writeContract({
+      account, chain: null, address: contract, abi: toolshedAbi,
+      functionName, args,
+    } as Parameters<typeof wallet.writeContract>[0]);
+    setMessage(`Submitted ${hash.slice(0, 12)}…`);
+    await publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
+    await refresh();
+  }
+
+  async function request(tool: Tool) {
+    if (!window.ethereum || !account) return setMessage("Connect your wallet first.");
+    setMessage("Approving exact deposit…");
+    const wallet = createWalletClient({ transport: custom(window.ethereum) });
+    const approval = await wallet.writeContract({
+      account, chain: null, address: usdc, abi: usdcAbi, functionName: "approve",
+      args: [contract, tool.deposit],
+    });
+    await publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash: approval });
+    await write("requestLoan", [tool.id, 3]);
+  }
+
+  async function listTool(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    const data = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
+    await write("listTool", [
+      String(data.get("name")), String(data.get("photo")),
+      String(data.get("condition")), parseUnits(String(data.get("deposit")), 6),
+      parseUnits(String(data.get("lateFee")), 6),
+    ]);
+    event.currentTarget.reset();
+  }
+
+  return <main>
+    <header>
+      <div><span className="eyebrow">NEIGHBORHOOD ASSOCIATION</span><h1>Toolshed</h1></div>
+      <button onClick={connect}>{account ? `${account.slice(0, 6)}…${account.slice(-4)}` : "Connect wallet"}</button>
+    </header>
+    {message && <p className="notice">{message}</p>}
+    <section className="intro">
+      <h2>Borrow what you need.<br />Return it neighborly.</h2>
+      <p>Deposits are held in USDC. Late fees go to the tool owner; the rest comes straight back.</p>
+    </section>
+    <section>
+      <div className="section-title"><h2>Available tools</h2><span>Reliable owners first</span></div>
+      <div className="grid">
+        {tools.map(tool => <article key={tool.id.toString()}>
+          <img src={tool.photoURI} alt="" />
+          <div className="card-body">
+            <h3>{tool.name}</h3><p>{tool.condition}</p>
+            <p className="reputation">{tool.completedLoans.toString()} loans · {tool.lateReturns.toString()} late</p>
+            <div className="terms"><b>{formatUnits(tool.deposit, 6)} USDC</b><span>{formatUnits(tool.dailyLateFee, 6)}/late day</span></div>
+            <button disabled={tool.status !== 0 || tool.owner === account} onClick={() => request(tool)}>
+              {tool.status === 0 ? "Request for 3 days" : "Unavailable"}
+            </button>
+          </div>
+        </article>)}
+      </div>
+    </section>
+    <section className="list-panel">
+      <div><span className="eyebrow">SHARE YOUR GEAR</span><h2>List a tool</h2><p>Use an IPFS or HTTPS photo URL. Amounts use USDC.</p></div>
+      <form onSubmit={listTool}>
+        <input name="name" placeholder="Tool name" required />
+        <input name="photo" placeholder="Photo URL" type="url" required />
+        <textarea name="condition" placeholder="Condition notes" required />
+        <div><input name="deposit" placeholder="Deposit" type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" required />
+          <input name="lateFee" placeholder="Daily late fee" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required /></div>
+        <button type="submit">Publish listing</button>
+      </form>
+    </section>
+    <footer>Toolshed v0.1 · Chain {chainId}</footer>
+  </main>;
+}
+
+ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById("root")!).render(<React.StrictMode><App /></React.StrictMode>);
+

+@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;600;700&family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,700&display=swap");
+:root { font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; color: #18372b; background: #f3f0e7; }
+* { box-sizing: border-box; }
+body { margin: 0; }
+main { max-width: 1180px; margin: auto; padding: 28px; }
+header, .section-title, .terms { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
+h1, h2, h3, p { margin-top: 0; }
+h1, h2, h3 { font-family: "Fraunces", serif; }
+h1 { font-size: 32px; margin-bottom: 0; } h2 { font-size: 34px; }
+.eyebrow { color: #cf5d3b; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .18em; }
+button { border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 12px 20px; background: #e96d45; color: white; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }
+button:disabled { background: #9a9a90; cursor: default; }
+.intro { background: #18372b; color: white; border-radius: 24px; padding: 54px; margin: 44px 0; }
+.intro h2 { font-size: clamp(40px, 6vw, 70px); line-height: 1; max-width: 760px; }
+.intro p { max-width: 520px; color: #c8d6ce; }
+.section-title span, .reputation { color: #6c786f; font-size: 14px; }
+.grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill,minmax(245px,1fr)); gap: 20px; }
+article { background: #fffdf6; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 8px 30px #18372b10; }
+article img { width: 100%; height: 190px; object-fit: cover; background: #dde1d7; }
+.card-body { padding: 20px; } .card-body button { width: 100%; margin-top: 14px; }
+.terms { border-top: 1px solid #deddd4; padding-top: 14px; font-size: 13px; }
+.list-panel { margin-top: 70px; padding: 44px; background: #e3ddc8; border-radius: 24px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr; gap: 40px; }
+form { display: grid; gap: 10px; } form div { display: flex; gap: 10px; }
+input, textarea { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #c5c1b2; background: #fffdf6; padding: 13px; border-radius: 9px; font: inherit; }
+textarea { min-height: 90px; resize: vertical; }
+.notice { position: sticky; top: 10px; z-index: 2; background: #fff4d4; padding: 12px 18px; border-radius: 9px; }
+footer { padding: 36px 0 10px; color: #6c786f; text-align: center; }
+@media (max-width: 700px) { .list-panel { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 28px; } .intro { padding: 35px 25px; } }
+

@@ -0,0 +1,110 @@
+# Toolshed
+
+Toolshed is a small, membership-gated lending library for a neighborhood
+association. It ships as a Solidity escrow contract and a React/Vite client.
+
+## Architecture
+
+- `contracts/Toolshed.sol` is the source of truth for membership, listings,
+  loan state, USDC escrow, late fees, and borrower reputation.
+- `web/src/` is a static client. It reads directly from an RPC endpoint and
+  writes through an injected wallet. No application server or private key is
+  required.
+- Photos are URLs, not chain data. Production should upload to a durable
+  HTTPS/IPFS service, then store its URL in the listing.
+- `test/Toolshed.t.sol` covers the money and permission-critical paths.
+
+One association-controlled admin address adds/removes members. A borrower
+requests an available tool and transfers the exact deposit to escrow. The
+owner accepts (starting the due-date clock) or rejects (full refund). On
+physical return the borrower calls `markReturned`, freezing fee accrual. The
+owner calls `confirmReturn`; the contract rounds partial late days up, pays
+the fee to the owner, refunds the remainder, and updates the borrower's
+completed/late counts. The fee cannot exceed the deposit. After seven days an
+association admin can settle a marked return if the owner is unresponsive.
+
+The client ranks listings by the owner's successful-return ratio and displays
+their loan counts. Contract reputation is the canonical data; a production
+indexer can apply the same ranking to owners and incoming borrower requests.
+The current client deliberately covers browsing, listing, and requesting.
+Owner approval, returns, member administration, and disputes are contract
+calls intended for the association's operator UI in the next version.
+
+## Local development
+
+Requirements: Node 20+, npm, Foundry, and an injected browser wallet.
+
+```sh
+forge test
+anvil
+```
+
+In a second terminal deploy a local mock USDC, then Toolshed. Anvil's first
+address is used below as the association admin:
+
+```sh
+forge create contracts/MockUSDC.sol:MockUSDC \
+  --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --private-key <ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY>
+
+USDC_ADDRESS=<MOCK_ADDRESS> ADMIN_ADDRESS=<ANVIL_ADDRESS> \
+  forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 \
+  --private-key <ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY> --broadcast
+```
+
+Copy `web/.env.example` to `web/.env`, fill in the two deployed addresses,
+then:
+
+```sh
+npm --prefix web install
+npm run web:dev
+```
+
+Add Anvil (`chainId 31337`) to the wallet. Use `cast send` or a block explorer
+to mint mock USDC and call `setMember(address,true)` for local accounts.
+Before requesting, the client submits an exact USDC approval automatically.
+
+Useful operator calls:
+
+```sh
+cast send <TOOLSHED> "setMember(address,bool)" <MEMBER> true \
+  --rpc-url <RPC_URL> --private-key <ADMIN_KEY>
+cast send <TOOLSHED> "approveLoan(uint256)" <LOAN_ID> \
+  --rpc-url <RPC_URL> --private-key <OWNER_KEY>
+cast send <TOOLSHED> "markReturned(uint256)" <LOAN_ID> \
+  --rpc-url <RPC_URL> --private-key <BORROWER_KEY>
+cast send <TOOLSHED> "confirmReturn(uint256)" <LOAN_ID> \
+  --rpc-url <RPC_URL> --private-key <OWNER_KEY>
+```
+
+## Production deployment
+
+1. Choose an EVM network with native USDC support and obtain its official
+   token address. Never deploy `MockUSDC` outside local/test environments.
+2. Use an association multisig for `ADMIN_ADDRESS`. Its responsibilities are
+   member admission/removal and stalled-return resolution.
+3. Simulate and deploy:
+
+   ```sh
+   USDC_ADDRESS=<OFFICIAL_USDC> ADMIN_ADDRESS=<MULTISIG> \
+     forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url <RPC_URL>
+   USDC_ADDRESS=<OFFICIAL_USDC> ADMIN_ADDRESS=<MULTISIG> \
+     forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url <RPC_URL> \
+     --private-key <DEPLOYER_KEY> --broadcast --verify
+   ```
+
+4. Set the web environment to the production RPC, chain ID, Toolshed address,
+   and USDC address. Run `npm --prefix web ci && npm run web:build`; deploy
+   `web/dist/` to any static host.
+5. Add the initial member set using the multisig and monitor
+   `LoanRequested`, `ReturnMarked`, and `LoanSettled` events.
+
+## V1 limits and operating policy
+
+The contract cannot establish whether a physical tool was damaged or truly
+returned. The association must define inspection/dispute policy; v1 only
+escrows lateness, and the admin backstop can settle a return but cannot assign
+extra damage charges. Listing text/URLs are public. Membership is on-chain
+allowlisting, not identity verification. Contracts are not audited; obtain an
+independent audit and test the selected USDC/network before holding real
+deposits.
+

--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+contract MockUSDC {
+    string public constant name = "Mock USDC";
+    string public constant symbol = "USDC";
+    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;
+    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;
+    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;
+
+    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external { balanceOf[to] += amount; }
+    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
+        allowance[msg.sender][spender] = amount;
+        return true;
+    }
+    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
+        balanceOf[msg.sender] -= amount;
+        balanceOf[to] += amount;
+        return true;
+    }
+    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
+        uint256 allowed = allowance[from][msg.sender];
+        if (allowed != type(uint256).max) allowance[from][msg.sender] = allowed - amount;
+        balanceOf[from] -= amount;
+        balanceOf[to] += amount;
+        return true;
+    }
+}
+
diff --git a/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-07-30T203242Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/contracts/Toolshed.sol b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-07-30T203242Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/contracts/Toolshed.sol

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..197cf5c4c41bc42676fa8b80259e258339ab0a88
--- /dev/null
+++ b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-07-30T203242Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/contracts/Toolshed.sol
@@ -0,0 +1,258 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+interface IERC20 {
+    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
+    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
+}
+
+/// @notice Membership-gated tool listings and USDC loan escrow.
+contract Toolshed {
+    enum ToolStatus { Available, Requested, Borrowed, ReturnPending }
+
+    struct Tool {
+        address owner;
+        string name;
+        string photoURI;
+        string condition;
+        uint96 deposit;
+        uint96 dailyLateFee;
+        ToolStatus status;
+        bool active;
+    }
+
+    struct Loan {
+        uint256 toolId;
+        address borrower;
+        uint64 requestedAt;
+        uint64 dueAt;
+        uint64 returnedAt;
+        uint32 durationDays;
+        uint96 deposit;
+        bool settled;
+    }
+
+    struct Reputation {
+        uint64 completedLoans;
+        uint64 lateReturns;
+    }
+
+    IERC20 public immutable usdc;
+    address public admin;
+    uint256 public toolCount;
+    uint256 public loanCount;
+    uint256 private unlocked = 1;
+
+    mapping(address => bool) public isMember;
+    mapping(uint256 => Tool) public tools;
+    mapping(uint256 => Loan) public loans;
+    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public currentLoanForTool;
+    mapping(address => Reputation) public reputation;
+
+    event MembershipSet(address indexed member, bool active);
+    event ToolListed(uint256 indexed toolId, address indexed owner);
+    event ToolUpdated(uint256 indexed toolId);
+    event LoanRequested(uint256 indexed loanId, uint256 indexed toolId, address indexed borrower);
+    event LoanApproved(uint256 indexed loanId, uint256 dueAt);
+    event LoanCancelled(uint256 indexed loanId);
+    event ReturnMarked(uint256 indexed loanId, uint256 returnedAt);
+    event LoanSettled(uint256 indexed loanId, uint256 ownerFee, uint256 borrowerRefund, bool late);
+
+    error Unauthorized();
+    error InvalidInput();
+    error InvalidState();
+    error TransferFailed();
+    error Reentrancy();
+
+    modifier onlyAdmin() {
+        if (msg.sender != admin) revert Unauthorized();
+        _;
+    }
+
+    modifier onlyMember() {
+        if (!isMember[msg.sender]) revert Unauthorized();
+        _;
+    }
+
+    modifier nonReentrant() {
+        if (unlocked != 1) revert Reentrancy();
+        unlocked = 2;
+        _;
+        unlocked = 1;
+    }
+
+    constructor(address usdc_, address admin_) {
+        if (usdc_ == address(0) || admin_ == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        usdc = IERC20(usdc_);
+        admin = admin_;
+        isMember[admin_] = true;
+        emit MembershipSet(admin_, true);
+    }
+
+    function setMember(address member, bool active) external onlyAdmin {
+        if (member == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        isMember[member] = active;
+        emit MembershipSet(member, active);
+    }
+
+    function transferAdmin(address nextAdmin) external onlyAdmin {
+        if (nextAdmin == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        admin = nextAdmin;
+        isMember[nextAdmin] = true;
+    }
+
+    function listTool(
+        string calldata name,
+        string calldata photoURI,
+        string calldata condition,
+        uint96 deposit,
+        uint96 dailyLateFee
+    ) external onlyMember returns (uint256 toolId) {
+        if (bytes(name).length == 0 || bytes(photoURI).length == 0 || deposit == 0 || dailyLateFee > deposit) {
+            revert InvalidInput();
+        }
+        toolId = ++toolCount;
+        tools[toolId] = Tool(
+            msg.sender, name, photoURI, condition, deposit, dailyLateFee, ToolStatus.Available, true
+        );
+        emit ToolListed(toolId, msg.sender);
+    }
+
+    function updateTool(
+        uint256 toolId,
+        string calldata name,
+        string calldata photoURI,
+        string calldata condition,
+        uint96 deposit,
+        uint96 dailyLateFee,
+        bool active
+    ) external {
+        Tool storage tool = tools[toolId];
+        if (msg.sender != tool.owner) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (tool.status != ToolStatus.Available) revert InvalidState();
+        if (bytes(name).length == 0 || bytes(photoURI).length == 0 || deposit == 0 || dailyLateFee > deposit) {
+            revert InvalidInput();
+        }
+        tool.name = name;
+        tool.photoURI = photoURI;
+        tool.condition = condition;
+        tool.deposit = deposit;
+        tool.dailyLateFee = dailyLateFee;
+        tool.active = active;
+        emit ToolUpdated(toolId);
+    }
+
+    function requestLoan(uint256 toolId, uint32 durationDays)
+        external
+        onlyMember
+        nonReentrant
+        returns (uint256 loanId)
+    {
+        Tool storage tool = tools[toolId];
+        if (!tool.active || tool.status != ToolStatus.Available || tool.owner == msg.sender) revert InvalidState();
+        if (durationDays == 0 || durationDays > 30) revert InvalidInput();
+
+        tool.status = ToolStatus.Requested;
+        loanId = ++loanCount;
+        loans[loanId] = Loan(
+            toolId, msg.sender, uint64(block.timestamp), 0, 0, durationDays, tool.deposit, false
+        );
+        currentLoanForTool[toolId] = loanId;
+        _safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), tool.deposit);
+        emit LoanRequested(loanId, toolId, msg.sender);
+    }
+
+    function approveLoan(uint256 loanId) external {
+        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];
+        Tool storage tool = tools[loan.toolId];
+        if (msg.sender != tool.owner) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (tool.status != ToolStatus.Requested || loan.settled) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.dueAt = uint64(block.timestamp + uint256(loan.durationDays) * 1 days);
+        tool.status = ToolStatus.Borrowed;
+        emit LoanApproved(loanId, loan.dueAt);
+    }
+
+    function cancelRequest(uint256 loanId) external nonReentrant {
+        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];
+        Tool storage tool = tools[loan.toolId];
+        if (msg.sender != loan.borrower && msg.sender != tool.owner) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (tool.status != ToolStatus.Requested || loan.settled) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.settled = true;
+        tool.status = ToolStatus.Available;
+        currentLoanForTool[loan.toolId] = 0;
+        _safeTransfer(loan.borrower, loan.deposit);
+        emit LoanCancelled(loanId);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice Borrower freezes late-fee accrual when physically returning the tool.
+    function markReturned(uint256 loanId) external {
+        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];
+        Tool storage tool = tools[loan.toolId];
+        if (msg.sender != loan.borrower) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (tool.status != ToolStatus.Borrowed || loan.settled) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.returnedAt = uint64(block.timestamp);
+        tool.status = ToolStatus.ReturnPending;
+        emit ReturnMarked(loanId, block.timestamp);
+    }
+
+    function confirmReturn(uint256 loanId) external nonReentrant {
+        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];
+        if (msg.sender != tools[loan.toolId].owner) revert Unauthorized();
+        _settle(loanId);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice Association backstop if an owner fails to confirm for seven days.
+    function resolveReturn(uint256 loanId) external onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
+        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];
+        if (loan.returnedAt == 0 || block.timestamp < uint256(loan.returnedAt) + 7 days) revert InvalidState();
+        _settle(loanId);
+    }
+
+    function quoteLateFee(uint256 loanId) public view returns (uint256 fee, bool late) {
+        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];
+        if (loan.dueAt == 0) return (0, false);
+        uint256 end = loan.returnedAt == 0 ? block.timestamp : loan.returnedAt;
+        if (end <= loan.dueAt) return (0, false);
+        late = true;
+        uint256 lateDays = (end - loan.dueAt + 1 days - 1) / 1 days;
+        fee = lateDays * tools[loan.toolId].dailyLateFee;
+        if (fee > loan.deposit) fee = loan.deposit;
+    }
+
+    /// @notice Basis-point reliability score; new members sort after proven perfect borrowers.
+    function reliabilityScore(address member) external view returns (uint256) {
+        Reputation memory rep = reputation[member];
+        if (rep.completedLoans == 0) return 0;
+        return uint256(rep.completedLoans - rep.lateReturns) * 10_000 / rep.completedLoans;
+    }
+
+    function _settle(uint256 loanId) private {
+        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];
+        Tool storage tool = tools[loan.toolId];
+        if (tool.status != ToolStatus.ReturnPending || loan.settled) revert InvalidState();
+        (uint256 fee, bool late) = quoteLateFee(loanId);
+        uint256 refund = loan.deposit - fee;
+        loan.settled = true;
+        tool.status = ToolStatus.Available;
+        currentLoanForTool[loan.toolId] = 0;
+        Reputation storage rep = reputation[loan.borrower];
+        rep.completedLoans++;
+        if (late) rep.lateReturns++;
+        if (fee != 0) _safeTransfer(tool.owner, fee);
+        if (refund != 0) _safeTransfer(loan.borrower, refund);
+        emit LoanSettled(loanId, fee, refund, late);
+    }
+
+    function _safeTransfer(address to, uint256 amount) private {
+        (bool ok, bytes memory data) =
+            address(usdc).call(abi.encodeCall(IERC20.transfer, (to, amount)));
+        if (!ok || (data.length != 0 && !abi.decode(data, (bool)))) revert TransferFailed();
+    }
+
+    function _safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) private {
+        (bool ok, bytes memory data) =
+            address(usdc).call(abi.encodeCall(IERC20.transferFrom, (from, to, amount)));
+        if (!ok || (data.length != 0 && !abi.decode(data, (bool)))) revert TransferFailed();
+    }
+}
+

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+import {Toolshed} from "../contracts/Toolshed.sol";
+
+interface Vm {
+    function envAddress(string calldata name) external returns (address);
+    function startBroadcast() external;
+    function stopBroadcast() external;
+}
+
+contract Deploy {
+    Vm private constant vm = Vm(address(uint160(uint256(keccak256("hevm cheat code")))));
+
+    function run() external returns (Toolshed instance) {
+        address usdc = vm.envAddress("USDC_ADDRESS");
+        address admin = vm.envAddress("ADMIN_ADDRESS");
+        vm.startBroadcast();
+        instance = new Toolshed(usdc, admin);
+        vm.stopBroadcast();
+    }
+}
+

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b92d94e62970919e2467d6abbc1d384b8382f36d
--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,108 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+import {Toolshed} from "../contracts/Toolshed.sol";
+import {MockUSDC} from "../contracts/MockUSDC.sol";
+
+interface Vm {
+    function prank(address) external;
+    function warp(uint256) external;
+    function expectRevert(bytes4) external;
+}
+
+contract ToolshedTest {
+    Vm private constant vm = Vm(address(uint160(uint256(keccak256("hevm cheat code")))));
+    address private constant OWNER = address(0xA11CE);
+    address private constant BORROWER = address(0xB0B);
+    MockUSDC private usdc;
+    Toolshed private toolshed;
+
+    function setUp() public {
+        usdc = new MockUSDC();
+        toolshed = new Toolshed(address(usdc), address(this));
+        toolshed.setMember(OWNER, true);
+        toolshed.setMember(BORROWER, true);
+        usdc.mint(BORROWER, 1_000e6);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        usdc.approve(address(toolshed), type(uint256).max);
+    }
+
+    function testOnTimeReturnRefundsDeposit() public {
+        uint256 toolId = _list();
+        uint256 loanId = _request(toolId, 3);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        toolshed.approveLoan(loanId);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        toolshed.markReturned(loanId);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        toolshed.confirmReturn(loanId);
+
+        _assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(BORROWER), 1_000e6);
+        (uint64 completed, uint64 late) = toolshed.reputation(BORROWER);
+        _assertEq(completed, 1);
+        _assertEq(late, 0);
+    }
+
+    function testLateFeeRoundsUpAndGoesToOwner() public {
+        uint256 toolId = _list();
+        uint256 loanId = _request(toolId, 2);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        toolshed.approveLoan(loanId);
+        (, , , uint64 dueAt, , , , ) = toolshed.loans(loanId);
+        vm.warp(uint256(dueAt) + 1 days + 1);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        toolshed.markReturned(loanId);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        toolshed.confirmReturn(loanId);
+
+        _assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(OWNER), 10e6);
+        _assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(BORROWER), 990e6);
+        (uint64 completed, uint64 late) = toolshed.reputation(BORROWER);
+        _assertEq(completed, 1);
+        _assertEq(late, 1);
+    }
+
+    function testLateFeeCannotExceedDeposit() public {
+        uint256 toolId = _list();
+        uint256 loanId = _request(toolId, 1);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        toolshed.approveLoan(loanId);
+        (, , , uint64 dueAt, , , , ) = toolshed.loans(loanId);
+        vm.warp(uint256(dueAt) + 50 days);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        toolshed.markReturned(loanId);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        toolshed.confirmReturn(loanId);
+        _assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(OWNER), 100e6);
+        _assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(BORROWER), 900e6);
+    }
+
+    function testNonMemberCannotList() public {
+        vm.prank(address(0xBAD));
+        vm.expectRevert(Toolshed.Unauthorized.selector);
+        toolshed.listTool("Saw", "ipfs://photo", "Good", 100e6, 5e6);
+    }
+
+    function testOwnerCanRejectAndEscrowIsRefunded() public {
+        uint256 toolId = _list();
+        uint256 loanId = _request(toolId, 3);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        toolshed.cancelRequest(loanId);
+        _assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(BORROWER), 1_000e6);
+    }
+
+    function _list() private returns (uint256) {
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        return toolshed.listTool("Circular saw", "ipfs://photo", "Blade recently changed", 100e6, 5e6);
+    }
+
+    function _request(uint256 toolId, uint32 daysRequested) private returns (uint256) {
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        return toolshed.requestLoan(toolId, daysRequested);
+    }
+
+    function _assertEq(uint256 actual, uint256 expected) private pure {
+        require(actual == expected, "not equal");
+    }
+}
+

+export const toolshedAbi = [
+  {
+    type: "function", name: "toolCount", stateMutability: "view", inputs: [],
+    outputs: [{ type: "uint256" }],
+  },
+  {
+    type: "function", name: "tools", stateMutability: "view",
+    inputs: [{ name: "", type: "uint256" }],
+    outputs: [
+      { name: "owner", type: "address" }, { name: "name", type: "string" },
+      { name: "photoURI", type: "string" }, { name: "condition", type: "string" },
+      { name: "deposit", type: "uint96" }, { name: "dailyLateFee", type: "uint96" },
+      { name: "status", type: "uint8" }, { name: "active", type: "bool" },
+    ],
+  },
+  {
+    type: "function", name: "reputation", stateMutability: "view",
+    inputs: [{ name: "", type: "address" }],
+    outputs: [{ name: "completedLoans", type: "uint64" }, { name: "lateReturns", type: "uint64" }],
+  },
+  {
+    type: "function", name: "listTool", stateMutability: "nonpayable",
+    inputs: [
+      { name: "name", type: "string" }, { name: "photoURI", type: "string" },
+      { name: "condition", type: "string" }, { name: "deposit", type: "uint96" },
+      { name: "dailyLateFee", type: "uint96" },
+    ], outputs: [{ name: "toolId", type: "uint256" }],
+  },
+  {
+    type: "function", name: "requestLoan", stateMutability: "nonpayable",
+    inputs: [{ name: "toolId", type: "uint256" }, { name: "durationDays", type: "uint32" }],
+    outputs: [{ name: "loanId", type: "uint256" }],
+  },
+] as const;
+
+export const usdcAbi = [{
+  type: "function", name: "approve", stateMutability: "nonpayable",
+  inputs: [{ name: "spender", type: "address" }, { name: "amount", type: "uint256" }],
+  outputs: [{ type: "bool" }],
+}] as const;
+
diff --git a/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-07-30T203242Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/web/src/main.tsx b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-07-30T203242Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/web/src/main.tsx

+++ b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-07-30T203242Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/web/src/main.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,149 @@
+import React, { FormEvent, useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import ReactDOM from "react-dom/client";
+import {
+  createPublicClient, createWalletClient, custom, formatUnits, http, parseUnits,
+  type Address,
+} from "viem";
+import { toolshedAbi, usdcAbi } from "./abi";
+import "./styles.css";
+
+declare global {
+  interface Window { ethereum?: Parameters<typeof custom>[0] }
+}
+
+const contract = import.meta.env.VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS as Address;
+const usdc = import.meta.env.VITE_USDC_ADDRESS as Address;
+const chainId = Number(import.meta.env.VITE_CHAIN_ID ?? 31337);
+const publicClient = createPublicClient({ transport: http(import.meta.env.VITE_RPC_URL) });
+
+type Tool = {
+  id: bigint;
+  owner: Address;
+  name: string;
+  photoURI: string;
+  condition: string;
+  deposit: bigint;
+  dailyLateFee: bigint;
+  status: number;
+  active: boolean;
+  completedLoans: bigint;
+  lateReturns: bigint;
+};
+
+function App() {
+  const [account, setAccount] = useState<Address>();
+  const [tools, setTools] = useState<Tool[]>([]);
+  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
+
+  async function refresh() {
+    const count = await publicClient.readContract({ address: contract, abi: toolshedAbi, functionName: "toolCount" });
+    const rows = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Number(count) }, async (_, index) => {
+      const id = BigInt(index + 1);
+      const [tool, rep] = await Promise.all([
+        publicClient.readContract({ address: contract, abi: toolshedAbi, functionName: "tools", args: [id] }),
+        publicClient.readContract({
+          address: contract, abi: toolshedAbi, functionName: "tools", args: [id],
+        }).then(result => publicClient.readContract({
+          address: contract, abi: toolshedAbi, functionName: "reputation", args: [result[0]],
+        })),
+      ]);
+      return {
+        id, owner: tool[0], name: tool[1], photoURI: tool[2], condition: tool[3],
+        deposit: tool[4], dailyLateFee: tool[5], status: tool[6], active: tool[7],
+        completedLoans: rep[0], lateReturns: rep[1],
+      };
+    }));
+    rows.sort((a, b) => {
+      const aGood = a.completedLoans - a.lateReturns;
+      const bGood = b.completedLoans - b.lateReturns;
+      return Number(bGood * (a.completedLoans || 1n) - aGood * (b.completedLoans || 1n));
+    });
+    setTools(rows.filter(tool => tool.active));
+  }
+
+  useEffect(() => { refresh().catch(error => setMessage(error.shortMessage ?? error.message)); }, []);
+
+  async function connect() {
+    if (!window.ethereum) return setMessage("Install an EIP-1193 wallet first.");
+    const [selected] = await createWalletClient({ transport: custom(window.ethereum) }).requestAddresses();
+    setAccount(selected);
+  }
+
+  async function write(functionName: "listTool" | "requestLoan", args: readonly unknown[]) {
+    if (!window.ethereum || !account) return setMessage("Connect your wallet first.");
+    const wallet = createWalletClient({ transport: custom(window.ethereum) });
+    const hash = await wallet.writeContract({
+      account, chain: null, address: contract, abi: toolshedAbi,
+      functionName, args,
+    } as Parameters<typeof wallet.writeContract>[0]);
+    setMessage(`Submitted ${hash.slice(0, 12)}…`);
+    await publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
+    await refresh();
+  }
+
+  async function request(tool: Tool) {
+    if (!window.ethereum || !account) return setMessage("Connect your wallet first.");
+    setMessage("Approving exact deposit…");
+    const wallet = createWalletClient({ transport: custom(window.ethereum) });
+    const approval = await wallet.writeContract({
+      account, chain: null, address: usdc, abi: usdcAbi, functionName: "approve",
+      args: [contract, tool.deposit],
+    });
+    await publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash: approval });
+    await write("requestLoan", [tool.id, 3]);
+  }
+
+  async function listTool(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    const data = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
+    await write("listTool", [
+      String(data.get("name")), String(data.get("photo")),
+      String(data.get("condition")), parseUnits(String(data.get("deposit")), 6),
+      parseUnits(String(data.get("lateFee")), 6),
+    ]);
+    event.currentTarget.reset();
+  }
+
+  return <main>
+    <header>
+      <div><span className="eyebrow">NEIGHBORHOOD ASSOCIATION</span><h1>Toolshed</h1></div>
+      <button onClick={connect}>{account ? `${account.slice(0, 6)}…${account.slice(-4)}` : "Connect wallet"}</button>
+    </header>
+    {message && <p className="notice">{message}</p>}
+    <section className="intro">
+      <h2>Borrow what you need.<br />Return it neighborly.</h2>
+      <p>Deposits are held in USDC. Late fees go to the tool owner; the rest comes straight back.</p>
+    </section>
+    <section>
+      <div className="section-title"><h2>Available tools</h2><span>Reliable owners first</span></div>
+      <div className="grid">
+        {tools.map(tool => <article key={tool.id.toString()}>
+          <img src={tool.photoURI} alt="" />
+          <div className="card-body">
+            <h3>{tool.name}</h3><p>{tool.condition}</p>
+            <p className="reputation">{tool.completedLoans.toString()} loans · {tool.lateReturns.toString()} late</p>
+            <div className="terms"><b>{formatUnits(tool.deposit, 6)} USDC</b><span>{formatUnits(tool.dailyLateFee, 6)}/late day</span></div>
+            <button disabled={tool.status !== 0 || tool.owner === account} onClick={() => request(tool)}>
+              {tool.status === 0 ? "Request for 3 days" : "Unavailable"}
+            </button>
+          </div>
+        </article>)}
+      </div>
+    </section>
+    <section className="list-panel">
+      <div><span className="eyebrow">SHARE YOUR GEAR</span><h2>List a tool</h2><p>Use an IPFS or HTTPS photo URL. Amounts use USDC.</p></div>
+      <form onSubmit={listTool}>
+        <input name="name" placeholder="Tool name" required />
+        <input name="photo" placeholder="Photo URL" type="url" required />
+        <textarea name="condition" placeholder="Condition notes" required />
+        <div><input name="deposit" placeholder="Deposit" type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" required />
+          <input name="lateFee" placeholder="Daily late fee" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required /></div>
+        <button type="submit">Publish listing</button>
+      </form>
+    </section>
+    <footer>Toolshed v0.1 · Chain {chainId}</footer>
+  </main>;
+}
+
+ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById("root")!).render(<React.StrictMode><App /></React.StrictMode>);
+

+@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;600;700&family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,700&display=swap");
+:root { font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; color: #18372b; background: #f3f0e7; }
+* { box-sizing: border-box; }
+body { margin: 0; }
+main { max-width: 1180px; margin: auto; padding: 28px; }
+header, .section-title, .terms { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
+h1, h2, h3, p { margin-top: 0; }
+h1, h2, h3 { font-family: "Fraunces", serif; }
+h1 { font-size: 32px; margin-bottom: 0; } h2 { font-size: 34px; }
+.eyebrow { color: #cf5d3b; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .18em; }
+button { border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 12px 20px; background: #e96d45; color: white; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }
+button:disabled { background: #9a9a90; cursor: default; }
+.intro { background: #18372b; color: white; border-radius: 24px; padding: 54px; margin: 44px 0; }
+.intro h2 { font-size: clamp(40px, 6vw, 70px); line-height: 1; max-width: 760px; }
+.intro p { max-width: 520px; color: #c8d6ce; }
+.section-title span, .reputation { color: #6c786f; font-size: 14px; }
+.grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill,minmax(245px,1fr)); gap: 20px; }
+article { background: #fffdf6; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 8px 30px #18372b10; }
+article img { width: 100%; height: 190px; object-fit: cover; background: #dde1d7; }
+.card-body { padding: 20px; } .card-body button { width: 100%; margin-top: 14px; }
+.terms { border-top: 1px solid #deddd4; padding-top: 14px; font-size: 13px; }
+.list-panel { margin-top: 70px; padding: 44px; background: #e3ddc8; border-radius: 24px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr; gap: 40px; }
+form { display: grid; gap: 10px; } form div { display: flex; gap: 10px; }
+input, textarea { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #c5c1b2; background: #fffdf6; padding: 13px; border-radius: 9px; font: inherit; }
+textarea { min-height: 90px; resize: vertical; }
+.notice { position: sticky; top: 10px; z-index: 2; background: #fff4d4; padding: 12px 18px; border-radius: 9px; }
+footer { padding: 36px 0 10px; color: #6c786f; text-align: center; }
+@media (max-width: 700px) { .list-panel { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 28px; } .intro { padding: 35px 25px; } }
+

@@ -0,0 +1,110 @@
+# Toolshed
+
+Toolshed is a small, membership-gated lending library for a neighborhood
+association. It ships as a Solidity escrow contract and a React/Vite client.
+
+## Architecture
+
+- `contracts/Toolshed.sol` is the source of truth for membership, listings,
+  loan state, USDC escrow, late fees, and borrower reputation.
+- `web/src/` is a static client. It reads directly from an RPC endpoint and
+  writes through an injected wallet. No application server or private key is
+  required.
+- Photos are URLs, not chain data. Production should upload to a durable
+  HTTPS/IPFS service, then store its URL in the listing.
+- `test/Toolshed.t.sol` covers the money and permission-critical paths.
+
+One association-controlled admin address adds/removes members. A borrower
+requests an available tool and transfers the exact deposit to escrow. The
+owner accepts (starting the due-date clock) or rejects (full refund). On
+physical return the borrower calls `markReturned`, freezing fee accrual. The
+owner calls `confirmReturn`; the contract rounds partial late days up, pays
+the fee to the owner, refunds the remainder, and updates the borrower's
+completed/late counts. The fee cannot exceed the deposit. After seven days an
+association admin can settle a marked return if the owner is unresponsive.
+
+The client ranks listings by the owner's successful-return ratio and displays
+their loan counts. Contract reputation is the canonical data; a production
+indexer can apply the same ranking to owners and incoming borrower requests.
+The current client deliberately covers browsing, listing, and requesting.
+Owner approval, returns, member administration, and disputes are contract
+calls intended for the association's operator UI in the next version.
+
+## Local development
+
+Requirements: Node 20+, npm, Foundry, and an injected browser wallet.
+
+```sh
+forge test
+anvil
+```
+
+In a second terminal deploy a local mock USDC, then Toolshed. Anvil's first
+address is used below as the association admin:
+
+```sh
+forge create contracts/MockUSDC.sol:MockUSDC \
+  --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --private-key <ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY>
+
+USDC_ADDRESS=<MOCK_ADDRESS> ADMIN_ADDRESS=<ANVIL_ADDRESS> \
+  forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 \
+  --private-key <ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY> --broadcast
+```
+
+Copy `web/.env.example` to `web/.env`, fill in the two deployed addresses,
+then:
+
+```sh
+npm --prefix web install
+npm run web:dev
+```
+
+Add Anvil (`chainId 31337`) to the wallet. Use `cast send` or a block explorer
+to mint mock USDC and call `setMember(address,true)` for local accounts.
+Before requesting, the client submits an exact USDC approval automatically.
+
+Useful operator calls:
+
+```sh
+cast send <TOOLSHED> "setMember(address,bool)" <MEMBER> true \
+  --rpc-url <RPC_URL> --private-key <ADMIN_KEY>
+cast send <TOOLSHED> "approveLoan(uint256)" <LOAN_ID> \
+  --rpc-url <RPC_URL> --private-key <OWNER_KEY>
+cast send <TOOLSHED> "markReturned(uint256)" <LOAN_ID> \
+  --rpc-url <RPC_URL> --private-key <BORROWER_KEY>
+cast send <TOOLSHED> "confirmReturn(uint256)" <LOAN_ID> \
+  --rpc-url <RPC_URL> --private-key <OWNER_KEY>
+```
+
+## Production deployment
+
+1. Choose an EVM network with native USDC support and obtain its official
+   token address. Never deploy `MockUSDC` outside local/test environments.
+2. Use an association multisig for `ADMIN_ADDRESS`. Its responsibilities are
+   member admission/removal and stalled-return resolution.
+3. Simulate and deploy:
+
+   ```sh
+   USDC_ADDRESS=<OFFICIAL_USDC> ADMIN_ADDRESS=<MULTISIG> \
+     forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url <RPC_URL>
+   USDC_ADDRESS=<OFFICIAL_USDC> ADMIN_ADDRESS=<MULTISIG> \
+     forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url <RPC_URL> \
+     --private-key <DEPLOYER_KEY> --broadcast --verify
+   ```
+
+4. Set the web environment to the production RPC, chain ID, Toolshed address,
+   and USDC address. Run `npm --prefix web ci && npm run web:build`; deploy
+   `web/dist/` to any static host.
+5. Add the initial member set using the multisig and monitor
+   `LoanRequested`, `ReturnMarked`, and `LoanSettled` events.
+
+## V1 limits and operating policy
+
+The contract cannot establish whether a physical tool was damaged or truly
+returned. The association must define inspection/dispute policy; v1 only
+escrows lateness, and the admin backstop can settle a return but cannot assign
+extra damage charges. Listing text/URLs are public. Membership is on-chain
+allowlisting, not identity verification. Contracts are not audited; obtain an
+independent audit and test the selected USDC/network before holding real
+deposits.
+

--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+contract MockUSDC {
+    string public constant name = "Mock USDC";
+    string public constant symbol = "USDC";
+    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;
+    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;
+    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;
+
+    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external { balanceOf[to] += amount; }
+    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
+        allowance[msg.sender][spender] = amount;
+        return true;
+    }
+    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
+        balanceOf[msg.sender] -= amount;
+        balanceOf[to] += amount;
+        return true;
+    }
+    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
+        uint256 allowed = allowance[from][msg.sender];
+        if (allowed != type(uint256).max) allowance[from][msg.sender] = allowed - amount;
+        balanceOf[from] -= amount;
+        balanceOf[to] += amount;
+        return true;
+    }
+}
+
diff --git a/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-07-30T203242Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/contracts/Toolshed.sol b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-07-30T203242Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/contracts/Toolshed.sol
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..197cf5c4c41bc42676fa8b80259e258339ab0a88
--- /dev/null
+++ b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-07-30T203242Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/contracts/Toolshed.sol
@@ -0,0 +1,258 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+interface IERC20 {
+    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
+    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
+}
+
+/// @notice Membership-gated tool listings and USDC loan escrow.
+contract Toolshed {
+    enum ToolStatus { Available, Requested, Borrowed, ReturnPending }
+
+    struct Tool {
+        address owner;
+        string name;
+        string photoURI;
+        string condition;
+        uint96 deposit;
+        uint96 dailyLateFee;
+        ToolStatus status;
+        bool active;
+    }
+
+    struct Loan {
+        uint256 toolId;
+        address borrower;
+        uint64 requestedAt;
+        uint64 dueAt;
+        uint64 returnedAt;
+        uint32 durationDays;
+        uint96 deposit;
+        bool settled;
+    }
+
+    struct Reputation {
+        uint64 completedLoans;
+        uint64 lateReturns;
+    }
+
+    IERC20 public immutable usdc;
+    address public admin;
+    uint256 public toolCount;
+    uint256 public loanCount;
+    uint256 private unlocked = 1;
+
+    mapping(address => bool) public isMember;
+    mapping(uint256 => Tool) public tools;
+    mapping(uint256 => Loan) public loans;
+    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public currentLoanForTool;
+    mapping(address => Reputation) public reputation;
+
+    event MembershipSet(address indexed member, bool active);
+    event ToolListed(uint256 indexed toolId, address indexed owner);
+    event ToolUpdated(uint256 indexed toolId);
+    event LoanRequested(uint256 indexed loanId, uint256 indexed toolId, address indexed borrower);
+    event LoanApproved(uint256 indexed loanId, uint256 dueAt);
+    event LoanCancelled(uint256 indexed loanId);
+    event ReturnMarked(uint256 indexed loanId, uint256 returnedAt);
+    event LoanSettled(uint256 indexed loanId, uint256 ownerFee, uint256 borrowerRefund, bool late);
+
+    error Unauthorized();
+    error InvalidInput();
+    error InvalidState();
+    error TransferFailed();
+    error Reentrancy();
+
+    modifier onlyAdmin() {
+        if (msg.sender != admin) revert Unauthorized();
+        _;
+    }
+
+    modifier onlyMember() {
+        if (!isMember[msg.sender]) revert Unauthorized();
+        _;
+    }
+
+    modifier nonReentrant() {
+        if (unlocked != 1) revert Reentrancy();
+        unlocked = 2;
+        _;
+        unlocked = 1;
+    }
+
+    constructor(address usdc_, address admin_) {
+        if (usdc_ == address(0) || admin_ == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        usdc = IERC20(usdc_);
+        admin = admin_;
+        isMember[admin_] = true;
+        emit MembershipSet(admin_, true);
+    }
+
+    function setMember(address member, bool active) external onlyAdmin {
+        if (member == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        isMember[member] = active;
+        emit MembershipSet(member, active);
+    }
+
+    function transferAdmin(address nextAdmin) external onlyAdmin {
+        if (nextAdmin == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        admin = nextAdmin;
+        isMember[nextAdmin] = true;
+    }
+
+    function listTool(
+        string calldata name,
+        string calldata photoURI,
+        string calldata condition,
+        uint96 deposit,
+        uint96 dailyLateFee
+    ) external onlyMember returns (uint256 toolId) {
+        if (bytes(name).length == 0 || bytes(photoURI).length == 0 || deposit == 0 || dailyLateFee > deposit) {
+            revert InvalidInput();
+        }
+        toolId = ++toolCount;
+        tools[toolId] = Tool(
+            msg.sender, name, photoURI, condition, deposit, dailyLateFee, ToolStatus.Available, true
+        );
+        emit ToolListed(toolId, msg.sender);
+    }
+
+    function updateTool(
+        uint256 toolId,
+        string calldata name,
+        string calldata photoURI,
+        string calldata condition,
+        uint96 deposit,
+        uint96 dailyLateFee,
+        bool active
+    ) external {
+        Tool storage tool = tools[toolId];
+        if (msg.sender != tool.owner) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (tool.status != ToolStatus.Available) revert InvalidState();
+        if (bytes(name).length == 0 || bytes(photoURI).length == 0 || deposit == 0 || dailyLateFee > deposit) {
+            revert InvalidInput();
+        }
+        tool.name = name;
+        tool.photoURI = photoURI;
+        tool.condition = condition;
+        tool.deposit = deposit;
+        tool.dailyLateFee = dailyLateFee;
+        tool.active = active;
+        emit ToolUpdated(toolId);
+    }
+
+    function requestLoan(uint256 toolId, uint32 durationDays)
+        external
+        onlyMember
+        nonReentrant
+        returns (uint256 loanId)
+    {
+        Tool storage tool = tools[toolId];
+        if (!tool.active || tool.status != ToolStatus.Available || tool.owner == msg.sender) revert InvalidState();
+        if (durationDays == 0 || durationDays > 30) revert InvalidInput();
+
+        tool.status = ToolStatus.Requested;
+        loanId = ++loanCount;
+        loans[loanId] = Loan(
+            toolId, msg.sender, uint64(block.timestamp), 0, 0, durationDays, tool.deposit, false
+        );
+        currentLoanForTool[toolId] = loanId;
+        _safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), tool.deposit);
+        emit LoanRequested(loanId, toolId, msg.sender);
+    }
+
+    function approveLoan(uint256 loanId) external {
+        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];
+        Tool storage tool = tools[loan.toolId];
+        if (msg.sender != tool.owner) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (tool.status != ToolStatus.Requested || loan.settled) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.dueAt = uint64(block.timestamp + uint256(loan.durationDays) * 1 days);
+        tool.status = ToolStatus.Borrowed;
+        emit LoanApproved(loanId, loan.dueAt);
+    }
+
+    function cancelRequest(uint256 loanId) external nonReentrant {
+        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];
+        Tool storage tool = tools[loan.toolId];
+        if (msg.sender != loan.borrower && msg.sender != tool.owner) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (tool.status != ToolStatus.Requested || loan.settled) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.settled = true;
+        tool.status = ToolStatus.Available;
+        currentLoanForTool[loan.toolId] = 0;
+        _safeTransfer(loan.borrower, loan.deposit);
+        emit LoanCancelled(loanId);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice Borrower freezes late-fee accrual when physically returning the tool.
+    function markReturned(uint256 loanId) external {
+        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];
+        Tool storage tool = tools[loan.toolId];
+        if (msg.sender != loan.borrower) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (tool.status != ToolStatus.Borrowed || loan.settled) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.returnedAt = uint64(block.timestamp);
+        tool.status = ToolStatus.ReturnPending;
+        emit ReturnMarked(loanId, block.timestamp);
+    }
+
+    function confirmReturn(uint256 loanId) external nonReentrant {
+        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];
+        if (msg.sender != tools[loan.toolId].owner) revert Unauthorized();
+        _settle(loanId);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice Association backstop if an owner fails to confirm for seven days.
+    function resolveReturn(uint256 loanId) external onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
+        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];
+        if (loan.returnedAt == 0 || block.timestamp < uint256(loan.returnedAt) + 7 days) revert InvalidState();
+        _settle(loanId);
+    }
+
+    function quoteLateFee(uint256 loanId) public view returns (uint256 fee, bool late) {
+        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];
+        if (loan.dueAt == 0) return (0, false);
+        uint256 end = loan.returnedAt == 0 ? block.timestamp : loan.returnedAt;
+        if (end <= loan.dueAt) return (0, false);
+        late = true;
+        uint256 lateDays = (end - loan.dueAt + 1 days - 1) / 1 days;
+        fee = lateDays * tools[loan.toolId].dailyLateFee;
+        if (fee > loan.deposit) fee = loan.deposit;
+    }
+
+    /// @notice Basis-point reliability score; new members sort after proven perfect borrowers.
+    function reliabilityScore(address member) external view returns (uint256) {
+        Reputation memory rep = reputation[member];
+        if (rep.completedLoans == 0) return 0;
+        return uint256(rep.completedLoans - rep.lateReturns) * 10_000 / rep.completedLoans;
+    }
+
+    function _settle(uint256 loanId) private {
+        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];
+        Tool storage tool = tools[loan.toolId];
+        if (tool.status != ToolStatus.ReturnPending || loan.settled) revert InvalidState();
+        (uint256 fee, bool late) = quoteLateFee(loanId);
+        uint256 refund = loan.deposit - fee;
+        loan.settled = true;
+        tool.status = ToolStatus.Available;
+        currentLoanForTool[loan.toolId] = 0;
+        Reputation storage rep = reputation[loan.borrower];
+        rep.completedLoans++;
+        if (late) rep.lateReturns++;
+        if (fee != 0) _safeTransfer(tool.owner, fee);
+        if (refund != 0) _safeTransfer(loan.borrower, refund);
+        emit LoanSettled(loanId, fee, refund, late);
+    }
+
+    function _safeTransfer(address to, uint256 amount) private {
+        (bool ok, bytes memory data) =
+            address(usdc).call(abi.encodeCall(IERC20.transfer, (to, amount)));
+        if (!ok || (data.length != 0 && !abi.decode(data, (bool)))) revert TransferFailed();
+    }
+
+    function _safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) private {
+        (bool ok, bytes memory data) =
+            address(usdc).call(abi.encodeCall(IERC20.transferFrom, (from, to, amount)));
+        if (!ok || (data.length != 0 && !abi.decode(data, (bool)))) revert TransferFailed();
+    }
+}
+

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+import {Toolshed} from "../contracts/Toolshed.sol";
+
+interface Vm {
+    function envAddress(string calldata name) external returns (address);
+    function startBroadcast() external;
+    function stopBroadcast() external;
+}
+
+contract Deploy {
+    Vm private constant vm = Vm(address(uint160(uint256(keccak256("hevm cheat code")))));
+
+    function run() external returns (Toolshed instance) {
+        address usdc = vm.envAddress("USDC_ADDRESS");
+        address admin = vm.envAddress("ADMIN_ADDRESS");
+        vm.startBroadcast();
+        instance = new Toolshed(usdc, admin);
+        vm.stopBroadcast();
+    }
+}
+

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b92d94e62970919e2467d6abbc1d384b8382f36d
--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,108 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+import {Toolshed} from "../contracts/Toolshed.sol";
+import {MockUSDC} from "../contracts/MockUSDC.sol";
+
+interface Vm {
+    function prank(address) external;
+    function warp(uint256) external;
+    function expectRevert(bytes4) external;
+}
+
+contract ToolshedTest {
+    Vm private constant vm = Vm(address(uint160(uint256(keccak256("hevm cheat code")))));
+    address private constant OWNER = address(0xA11CE);
+    address private constant BORROWER = address(0xB0B);
+    MockUSDC private usdc;
+    Toolshed private toolshed;
+
+    function setUp() public {
+        usdc = new MockUSDC();
+        toolshed = new Toolshed(address(usdc), address(this));
+        toolshed.setMember(OWNER, true);
+        toolshed.setMember(BORROWER, true);
+        usdc.mint(BORROWER, 1_000e6);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        usdc.approve(address(toolshed), type(uint256).max);
+    }
+
+    function testOnTimeReturnRefundsDeposit() public {
+        uint256 toolId = _list();
+        uint256 loanId = _request(toolId, 3);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        toolshed.approveLoan(loanId);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        toolshed.markReturned(loanId);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        toolshed.confirmReturn(loanId);
+
+        _assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(BORROWER), 1_000e6);
+        (uint64 completed, uint64 late) = toolshed.reputation(BORROWER);
+        _assertEq(completed, 1);
+        _assertEq(late, 0);
+    }
+
+    function testLateFeeRoundsUpAndGoesToOwner() public {
+        uint256 toolId = _list();
+        uint256 loanId = _request(toolId, 2);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        toolshed.approveLoan(loanId);
+        (, , , uint64 dueAt, , , , ) = toolshed.loans(loanId);
+        vm.warp(uint256(dueAt) + 1 days + 1);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        toolshed.markReturned(loanId);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        toolshed.confirmReturn(loanId);
+
+        _assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(OWNER), 10e6);
+        _assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(BORROWER), 990e6);
+        (uint64 completed, uint64 late) = toolshed.reputation(BORROWER);
+        _assertEq(completed, 1);
+        _assertEq(late, 1);
+    }
+
+    function testLateFeeCannotExceedDeposit() public {
+        uint256 toolId = _list();
+        uint256 loanId = _request(toolId, 1);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        toolshed.approveLoan(loanId);
+        (, , , uint64 dueAt, , , , ) = toolshed.loans(loanId);
+        vm.warp(uint256(dueAt) + 50 days);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        toolshed.markReturned(loanId);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        toolshed.confirmReturn(loanId);
+        _assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(OWNER), 100e6);
+        _assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(BORROWER), 900e6);
+    }
+
+    function testNonMemberCannotList() public {
+        vm.prank(address(0xBAD));
+        vm.expectRevert(Toolshed.Unauthorized.selector);
+        toolshed.listTool("Saw", "ipfs://photo", "Good", 100e6, 5e6);
+    }
+
+    function testOwnerCanRejectAndEscrowIsRefunded() public {
+        uint256 toolId = _list();
+        uint256 loanId = _request(toolId, 3);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        toolshed.cancelRequest(loanId);
+        _assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(BORROWER), 1_000e6);
+    }
+
+    function _list() private returns (uint256) {
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        return toolshed.listTool("Circular saw", "ipfs://photo", "Blade recently changed", 100e6, 5e6);
+    }
+
+    function _request(uint256 toolId, uint32 daysRequested) private returns (uint256) {
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        return toolshed.requestLoan(toolId, daysRequested);
+    }
+
+    function _assertEq(uint256 actual, uint256 expected) private pure {
+        require(actual == expected, "not equal");
+    }
+}
+

+<div id="root"></div><script type="module" src="/src/main.tsx"></script>
+

+export const toolshedAbi = [
+  {
+    type: "function", name: "toolCount", stateMutability: "view", inputs: [],
+    outputs: [{ type: "uint256" }],
+  },
+  {
+    type: "function", name: "tools", stateMutability: "view",
+    inputs: [{ name: "", type: "uint256" }],
+    outputs: [
+      { name: "owner", type: "address" }, { name: "name", type: "string" },
+      { name: "photoURI", type: "string" }, { name: "condition", type: "string" },
+      { name: "deposit", type: "uint96" }, { name: "dailyLateFee", type: "uint96" },
+      { name: "status", type: "uint8" }, { name: "active", type: "bool" },
+    ],
+  },
+  {
+    type: "function", name: "reputation", stateMutability: "view",
+    inputs: [{ name: "", type: "address" }],
+    outputs: [{ name: "completedLoans", type: "uint64" }, { name: "lateReturns", type: "uint64" }],
+  },
+  {
+    type: "function", name: "listTool", stateMutability: "nonpayable",
+    inputs: [
+      { name: "name", type: "string" }, { name: "photoURI", type: "string" },
+      { name: "condition", type: "string" }, { name: "deposit", type: "uint96" },
+      { name: "dailyLateFee", type: "uint96" },
+    ], outputs: [{ name: "toolId", type: "uint256" }],
+  },
+  {
+    type: "function", name: "requestLoan", stateMutability: "nonpayable",
+    inputs: [{ name: "toolId", type: "uint256" }, { name: "durationDays", type: "uint32" }],
+    outputs: [{ name: "loanId", type: "uint256" }],
+  },
+] as const;
+
+export const usdcAbi = [{
+  type: "function", name: "approve", stateMutability: "nonpayable",
+  inputs: [{ name: "spender", type: "address" }, { name: "amount", type: "uint256" }],
+  outputs: [{ type: "bool" }],
+}] as const;
+
diff --git a/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-07-30T203242Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/web/src/main.tsx b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-07-30T203242Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/web/src/main.tsx

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..22a6baeab23259b7eb95d7d523011a07e4cc06ad

@@ -0,0 +1,149 @@
+import React, { FormEvent, useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import ReactDOM from "react-dom/client";
+import {
+  createPublicClient, createWalletClient, custom, formatUnits, http, parseUnits,
+  type Address,
+} from "viem";
+import { toolshedAbi, usdcAbi } from "./abi";
+import "./styles.css";
+
+declare global {
+  interface Window { ethereum?: Parameters<typeof custom>[0] }
+}
+
+const contract = import.meta.env.VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS as Address;
+const usdc = import.meta.env.VITE_USDC_ADDRESS as Address;
+const chainId = Number(import.meta.env.VITE_CHAIN_ID ?? 31337);
+const publicClient = createPublicClient({ transport: http(import.meta.env.VITE_RPC_URL) });
+
+type Tool = {
+  id: bigint;
+  owner: Address;
+  name: string;
+  photoURI: string;
+  condition: string;
+  deposit: bigint;
+  dailyLateFee: bigint;
+  status: number;
+  active: boolean;
+  completedLoans: bigint;
+  lateReturns: bigint;
+};
+
+function App() {
+  const [account, setAccount] = useState<Address>();
+  const [tools, setTools] = useState<Tool[]>([]);
+  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
+
+  async function refresh() {
+    const count = await publicClient.readContract({ address: contract, abi: toolshedAbi, functionName: "toolCount" });
+    const rows = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Number(count) }, async (_, index) => {
+      const id = BigInt(index + 1);
+      const [tool, rep] = await Promise.all([
+        publicClient.readContract({ address: contract, abi: toolshedAbi, functionName: "tools", args: [id] }),
+        publicClient.readContract({
+          address: contract, abi: toolshedAbi, functionName: "tools", args: [id],
+        }).then(result => publicClient.readContract({
+          address: contract, abi: toolshedAbi, functionName: "reputation", args: [result[0]],
+        })),
+      ]);
+      return {
+        id, owner: tool[0], name: tool[1], photoURI: tool[2], condition: tool[3],
+        deposit: tool[4], dailyLateFee: tool[5], status: tool[6], active: tool[7],
+        completedLoans: rep[0], lateReturns: rep[1],
+      };
+    }));
+    rows.sort((a, b) => {
+      const aGood = a.completedLoans - a.lateReturns;
+      const bGood = b.completedLoans - b.lateReturns;
+      return Number(bGood * (a.completedLoans || 1n) - aGood * (b.completedLoans || 1n));
+    });
+    setTools(rows.filter(tool => tool.active));
+  }
+
+  useEffect(() => { refresh().catch(error => setMessage(error.shortMessage ?? error.message)); }, []);
+
+  async function connect() {
+    if (!window.ethereum) return setMessage("Install an EIP-1193 wallet first.");
+    const [selected] = await createWalletClient({ transport: custom(window.ethereum) }).requestAddresses();
+    setAccount(selected);
+  }
+
+  async function write(functionName: "listTool" | "requestLoan", args: readonly unknown[]) {
+    if (!window.ethereum || !account) return setMessage("Connect your wallet first.");
+    const wallet = createWalletClient({ transport: custom(window.ethereum) });
+    const hash = await wallet.writeContract({
+      account, chain: null, address: contract, abi: toolshedAbi,
+      functionName, args,
+    } as Parameters<typeof wallet.writeContract>[0]);
+    setMessage(`Submitted ${hash.slice(0, 12)}…`);
+    await publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
+    await refresh();
+  }
+
+  async function request(tool: Tool) {
+    if (!window.ethereum || !account) return setMessage("Connect your wallet first.");
+    setMessage("Approving exact deposit…");
+    const wallet = createWalletClient({ transport: custom(window.ethereum) });
+    const approval = await wallet.writeContract({
+      account, chain: null, address: usdc, abi: usdcAbi, functionName: "approve",
+      args: [contract, tool.deposit],
+    });
+    await publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash: approval });
+    await write("requestLoan", [tool.id, 3]);
+  }
+
+  async function listTool(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    const data = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
+    await write("listTool", [
+      String(data.get("name")), String(data.get("photo")),
+      String(data.get("condition")), parseUnits(String(data.get("deposit")), 6),
+      parseUnits(String(data.get("lateFee")), 6),
+    ]);
+    event.currentTarget.reset();
+  }
+
+  return <main>
+    <header>
+      <div><span className="eyebrow">NEIGHBORHOOD ASSOCIATION</span><h1>Toolshed</h1></div>
+      <button onClick={connect}>{account ? `${account.slice(0, 6)}…${account.slice(-4)}` : "Connect wallet"}</button>
+    </header>
+    {message && <p className="notice">{message}</p>}
+    <section className="intro">
+      <h2>Borrow what you need.<br />Return it neighborly.</h2>
+      <p>Deposits are held in USDC. Late fees go to the tool owner; the rest comes straight back.</p>
+    </section>
+    <section>
+      <div className="section-title"><h2>Available tools</h2><span>Reliable owners first</span></div>
+      <div className="grid">
+        {tools.map(tool => <article key={tool.id.toString()}>
+          <img src={tool.photoURI} alt="" />
+          <div className="card-body">
+            <h3>{tool.name}</h3><p>{tool.condition}</p>
+            <p className="reputation">{tool.completedLoans.toString()} loans · {tool.lateReturns.toString()} late</p>
+            <div className="terms"><b>{formatUnits(tool.deposit, 6)} USDC</b><span>{formatUnits(tool.dailyLateFee, 6)}/late day</span></div>
+            <button disabled={tool.status !== 0 || tool.owner === account} onClick={() => request(tool)}>
+              {tool.status === 0 ? "Request for 3 days" : "Unavailable"}
+            </button>
+          </div>
+        </article>)}
+      </div>
+    </section>
+    <section className="list-panel">
+      <div><span className="eyebrow">SHARE YOUR GEAR</span><h2>List a tool</h2><p>Use an IPFS or HTTPS photo URL. Amounts use USDC.</p></div>
+      <form onSubmit={listTool}>
+        <input name="name" placeholder="Tool name" required />
+        <input name="photo" placeholder="Photo URL" type="url" required />
+        <textarea name="condition" placeholder="Condition notes" required />
+        <div><input name="deposit" placeholder="Deposit" type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" required />
+          <input name="lateFee" placeholder="Daily late fee" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required /></div>
+        <button type="submit">Publish listing</button>
+      </form>
+    </section>
+    <footer>Toolshed v0.1 · Chain {chainId}</footer>
+  </main>;
+}
+
+ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById("root")!).render(<React.StrictMode><App /></React.StrictMode>);
+
diff --git a/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-07-30T203242Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/web/src/styles.css b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-07-30T203242Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/web/src/styles.css

@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;600;700&family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,700&display=swap");
+:root { font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; color: #18372b; background: #f3f0e7; }
+* { box-sizing: border-box; }
+body { margin: 0; }
+main { max-width: 1180px; margin: auto; padding: 28px; }
+header, .section-title, .terms { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
+h1, h2, h3, p { margin-top: 0; }
+h1, h2, h3 { font-family: "Fraunces", serif; }
+h1 { font-size: 32px; margin-bottom: 0; } h2 { font-size: 34px; }
+.eyebrow { color: #cf5d3b; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .18em; }
+button { border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 12px 20px; background: #e96d45; color: white; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }
+button:disabled { background: #9a9a90; cursor: default; }
+.intro { background: #18372b; color: white; border-radius: 24px; padding: 54px; margin: 44px 0; }
+.intro h2 { font-size: clamp(40px, 6vw, 70px); line-height: 1; max-width: 760px; }
+.intro p { max-width: 520px; color: #c8d6ce; }
+.section-title span, .reputation { color: #6c786f; font-size: 14px; }
+.grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill,minmax(245px,1fr)); gap: 20px; }
+article { background: #fffdf6; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 8px 30px #18372b10; }
+article img { width: 100%; height: 190px; object-fit: cover; background: #dde1d7; }
+.card-body { padding: 20px; } .card-body button { width: 100%; margin-top: 14px; }
+.terms { border-top: 1px solid #deddd4; padding-top: 14px; font-size: 13px; }
+.list-panel { margin-top: 70px; padding: 44px; background: #e3ddc8; border-radius: 24px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr; gap: 40px; }
+form { display: grid; gap: 10px; } form div { display: flex; gap: 10px; }
+input, textarea { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #c5c1b2; background: #fffdf6; padding: 13px; border-radius: 9px; font: inherit; }
+textarea { min-height: 90px; resize: vertical; }
+.notice { position: sticky; top: 10px; z-index: 2; background: #fff4d4; padding: 12px 18px; border-radius: 9px; }
+footer { padding: 36px 0 10px; color: #6c786f; text-align: center; }
+@media (max-width: 700px) { .list-panel { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 28px; } .intro { padding: 35px 25px; } }
+
